raw:
I've proposed 30 hypotheses, mostly self-conditioning (an edit helps more when it replaces a weak op such as none or avg_pool than a strong one) plus disconnection through edge 0. I haven't tested any of them against benchmark data. They rest on prior knowledge of NAS-Bench-201 op strengths, and the ceiling hypothesis (the edge 1 → conv3x3 edit conditioned on edge 3 being conv3x3) is the least certain.
